title: Process Tasks Using Servers
summary: Given two arrays, servers and tasks, where servers[i] represents the weight of the i-th server and tasks[j] the time needed to process the j-th task, assign tasks to servers using a task queue.
statement: Given two arrays, servers and tasks, where servers[i] represents the weight of the i-th server and tasks[j] the time needed to process the j-th task, assign tasks to servers using a task queue. Initialize an array ans of length m to store the server index for each task. At second j, insert the j-th task into the queue. Assign tasks to free servers based on weight and index, and if no servers are free, wait until one becomes available. Record the server index for each task in the ans array.
constraints: Each list has length 1 through 200000 and all values are positive.
Task i arrives at second i and waiting tasks remain in arrival order.
Choose a free server by lowest weight, then lowest index; if none is free, advance to the earliest release.
reference_solution:
def assign_tasks_to_servers(servers, tasks):
    from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush
    idle = [(weight, index) for index, weight in enumerate(servers)]
    heapify(idle)
    busy = []
    answer = []
    time = 0
    for arrival, duration in enumerate(tasks):
        time = max(time, arrival)
        while busy and busy[0][0] <= time:
            release, weight, index = heappop(busy)
            heappush(idle, (weight, index))
        if not idle:
            time = busy[0][0]
            while busy and busy[0][0] <= time:
                release, weight, index = heappop(busy)
                heappush(idle, (weight, index))
        weight, index = heappop(idle)
        answer.append(index)
        heappush(busy, (time + duration, weight, index))
    return answer

hints: Use one heap for idle servers ordered by weight/index and another for busy servers ordered by release time.
At each arrival, release every server available by the current time; if idle is empty, jump to the next release and release all ties.
Take the best idle server and push its new release record into the busy heap.
Tasks are processed in arrival order, while the two heap orderings exactly implement the server-choice and earliest-time rules.
